dict.string: Hermes doctor checks which applications are reachable via Apple Events automation. No automation is performed without user consent.
Hermes doctor checks microphone access status for plugin-voice. The probe does not capture audio.
Hermes doctor checks camera access status. The probe does not capture video.
Hermes doctor checks read access to ~/Documents for plugin-backups. The probe does not read user documents.
Hermes doctor checks read access to ~/Desktop for plugin-backups. The probe does not read desktop files.
Hermes doctor checks read access to ~/Downloads. The probe does not read downloads.
Hermes doctor checks Speech Recognition access status. The probe does not perform recognition.
